content.comment_body: Hello! Is it possible to modify Weekly Timer ON/OFF parameters on [article_no] through the device display using references? I was able to do this with the Analog Threshold Trigger, but the Weekly Timer appears to lack this capability. If anyone knows a solution, please advise. Thanks for your help and for making this forum so informative! Best regards, [user_name]

Hi [user_name], you can't draw reference lines to the Weekly Timer. However, you can enter the ON and OFF times using "Parameter VM mapping," which allows you to write values to these variables. Regards, [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: A user wants to adjust Weekly Timer ON/OFF parameters through the display using references, as is done with Analog Threshold Trigger. It is confirmed that direct referencing for Weekly Timer is not available, but parameters can be updated using variable mapping as a workaround. This reveals a restriction in how Weekly Timer blocks can be interactively configured via the device display.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects to be able to update Weekly Timer ON/OFF times through the display, just like with Analog Threshold Trigger.
